title: Scorch
description: Your recently played covers stacked like sheets of paper, with each artwork’s own ink as the fuel — hold still until a spot catches and a glowing char line races along the dark type and shapes, leaving pale paper standing as islands. Drag to fan the front or blow it out; at 92% burnt the scraps go and the cover underneath becomes the sheet.
intent: A heat-and-fuel burn sim on the GPU where the cover’s dark ink burns fastest, so lighting the lettering sends a fuse through the artwork and through to the next cover.
